title: Local module assignment prevents the validation stage from starting
impact: Python binds module locally throughout main because package metadata is assigned to module at line 274. The loader call at line 148 raises UnboundLocalError before guards, compilation or the selected tests can run.
required_fix: Rename the package metadata variable or the loader without changing the reviewed source inventory; add a pure lexical/reachability regression check. Preserve this sealed v2 and issue a successor.

title: Early guarded failure cannot publish the failed closure receipt
impact: closed() is defined inside the guarded try after input acquisition, runtime acquisition and scratch setup. If input_guard.acquire raises, cleanup runs but the final failed branch calls an uninitialized local closed, replacing the original error with UnboundLocalError and leaving validation.closed.json absent.
required_fix: Make failure finalization available before every guarded failure and retain the original phase error, observed Job ledger and cleanup state. Exercise input/runtime acquisition failures with pure adapters.

title: Cleanup receipt failure still skips later guard closes
impact: Both finally loops catch guard.close errors but write each receipt outside that handler before advancing to the next guard. An ordinary receipt write OSError after the first close aborts the loop, leaving later guards without close attempts or observations.
required_fix: Complete all guard close attempts independently of receipt persistence, retain both close and persistence errors, and only then publish cleanup/failed state; do not publish ready or partial success on persistence failure.
